title: Argo Exo

hero.kicker: A wearable computer, run by agents you own
hero.headline: Your agents can propose anything. Only your rules and your finger move the money.
hero.lede: Exo is a computer you wear: display glasses, earbuds and a few keys on a sling. Hold a button and speak to your own open-source agents. Every transaction they propose is simulated, checked against your rules by a Chainlink CRE workflow, explained in your ear, and sent only when you press the approve key.

features.heading: The Apparatus
features.intro: Eleven parts of one idea: hand the routine to AI agents without handing over your keys, and without being stuck at a screen. Some of it you wear, some of it runs on a server you own, and some of it lives onchain where no one can quietly change it.

kit.heading: The Kits
kit.intro: Exo is planned as a fully assembled kit, tested button by button. The deck alone if you already own compatible glasses, or the complete kit. Nothing is for sale yet; join the waitlist to hear when it is.

items.q: Can the AI agent spend my money?
items.a: No. The agents can only propose a transaction. A Chainlink CRE workflow simulates it, checks it against your rules and writes an approval for that exact transaction onchain. Then you press the approve key. The key on the device holds only gas, and your savings sit with a cold key that never goes online.

Anything over your limits, payments to strangers above your threshold, unlimited token approvals, approvals to unknown contracts, setApprovalForAll, anything built from a camera photo, anything that reverts, and anything whose effects don't match what the agent said it would do. Today it also refuses swaps, marketplace purchases and votes, because it doesn't decode those functions yet. It refuses what it doesn't understand.

items.q: Is it live on Ethereum mainnet?
items.a: The Guardian runs in Chainlink's CRE simulator against live mainnet data, and has approved and refused real transactions there. It isn't deployed to a Chainlink DON or a TEE yet. We'll say so plainly until it is.

items.q: Does it record all the time?
items.a: No. The camera takes a photo or a clip only when you press its button, and the microphone listens only while you hold talk or record a memo. A red light faces outward whenever either is on.
Your own Hermes agent server (a small cloud server is enough), a Deepgram key for speech, and display glasses that take a USB-C DisplayPort signal, or the complete kit, which includes them.
Yes. The deck, the Guardian workflow, the Safe module and the wiring guide are MIT-licensed on GitHub. You can read every line that touches your wallet, and run all of it without us.
Exo is built by hand in small batches, and isn't for sale yet. Everyone on the waitlist hears first, with a real date. We won't promise one we can't keep.

prototype.heading: The Prototype
prototype.intro: What exists today, photographed on the hackathon table in Singapore: the Raspberry Pi deck, the display glasses, the breadboard of keys and the recording light, the camera clip and the Pi Zero that holds the cold key. Below them, the dashboard as it appears in the glasses.

receipt.claim_intro: Tell us where to ship your Exo. Your wallet signs these details to prove you hold this receipt. They're stored on our server only, never onchain.
receipt.heading: Argo Exo · Apparatus
receipt.nft_note: Your receipt is an NFT in your wallet. Whoever holds it when your batch ships receives the device.
receipt.saved: Saved. We'll email you before your batch is built.

terms.refund: Until your Exo ships, you can cancel for a full refund of the USDC you paid, sent to the wallet that holds the receipt. The receipt is burned and its number retired. After shipping, a faulty device is repaired or replaced.
terms.payment: Payment is in USDC on Base only, from your own wallet. The price is read from the pre-order contract at the moment you buy, and your wallet signs a maximum price so you can never be charged more than you saw. You pay the network fee.
terms.shipping: Each Exo is assembled by hand in small batches. We email every holder a shipping window before their batch is built. Shipping, import duty and local taxes are paid by the buyer and quoted before dispatch.
terms.receipt: An ERC-721 token, Argo Exo · Apparatus No. N, minted to your wallet in the same transaction as your payment. It's transferable: whoever holds it when your batch ships receives the device.
terms.price: Set per kit in the contract. Shown on the page only after it's read from the chain.
